Śaucasaṃtoṣatapaḥsvādhyāyeśvarapraṇidhānāni niyamāḥ /II.32/
Śauca-saṃtoṣa-tapaḥ-svādhyāya-īśvara-praṇidhānāni niyamāḥ /II.32/

 « Les astreintes
1280 sont la pureté, le contentement, la mortification ardente, la
cantillation personnelle et le fait de déposer [les fruits des actes] pour le Seigneur. »

Tatra śaucaṃ mṛj-jala-ādi-janitaṃ medhya-abhyavaharaṇa-ādi ca bāhyam / Ābhyantaraṃ
citta-malānām ākṣālanam / Saṃtoṣaḥ sannihita-sādhanād adhikasya–anupāditsā / Tapo
dvaṃdva-sahanam / Dvaṃdvaṃ ca
1281 jighatsā-pipāse śīta-uṣṇe sthāna-āsane kāṣṭha-mauna-
ākāra-maune ca / Vratāni ca–eṣāṃ yathā-yogaṃ kṛcchra-cāndrāyaṇa-sāṃtapana-ādīni
svādhyāyo mokṣa-
